set.body:
Why: singularValues means covariance SVs (PLSC), canonical correlations (CCA), or fitted-matrix SVs (RRR) in one untyped slot (PairedLatent.scala:63). rawDecomposition is Option[SvdResult]; PlscFit.result / CcaFit.result throw IllegalStateException when it is absent (Decompositions.scala). One overloaded slot + a throwing accessor.

Scope: introduce one LatentFit (scores, loadings, Spectrum, diagnostics, map). Spectrum = enum Eigenvalues | SingularValues | CanonicalCorrelations | Covariance. Make PcaFit/PlscFit/CcaFit/ReducedRankRegressionFit thin newtypes over it or delete them.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] A Spectrum ADT distinguishes eigenvalues / singular values / canonical correlations / covariance SVs.
- [ ] No throwing .result accessor remains (rawDecomposition either always-present or replaced by Spectrum).
- [ ] Each method populates the correct Spectrum variant; a test asserts CCA=CanonicalCorrelations, PLSC=Covariance, RRR=SingularValues.
- [ ] Paired parity fixtures still pass on JVM+JS; all public call sites updated.
set.title: multivar: unify fit result into one LatentFit with a discriminated Spectrum
